visual_action: Musician Maggie Rogers stands on a stage at a rally, holding an acoustic guitar and speaking into a microphone. In the background, a large crowd holds up orange signs that say "VOTE". After speaking, she begins to play her guitar and sing.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Maggie Rogers refers to her as "Vice President Harris" and "soon to be... Madam President".

cast.name: Maggie Rogers
cast.evidence: On-screen text identifies her: "Maggie Rogers just hit the campaign trail for Kamala".

on_screen_text.text: Maggie Rogers just hit the campaign trail for Kamala 💌💙

spoken_summary: Maggie Rogers addresses a cheering crowd, referring to Kamala Harris as "Vice President Harris, soon to be, with your help, Madam President." After the crowd's loud applause, she says, "Let's do this," and begins to play a song on her acoustic guitar.
audio_music: The video begins with the sound of a large, cheering crowd. After about 12 seconds of speech and cheering, the audio transitions to Maggie Rogers playing a melodic song on an acoustic guitar and singing.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static shot focused on the performer. Text overlays appear and disappear sequentially to emphasize parts of the speech.
central_claim: Musician Maggie Rogers is endorsing and performing at a campaign rally for Kamala Harris's presidential bid.
intended_effect: To build excitement and rally support for Kamala Harris by showcasing a celebrity endorsement from a popular musician.
